replacements.oldText: Use the purity established during the evaluation when comparing a real offer.
replacements.newText:
Use the purity established during the evaluation when comparing a real offer. Our guide to 14K marks, color and construction explains what these descriptions tell you.

A marking is a starting clue: stamps can wear, repairs can introduce other metals, and separate components may have different purities. Ask how purity will be checked and whether a proposed test could mark the piece. GIA’s 1992 study of gold-testing methods provides historical background on touchstone, electronic and X-ray fluorescence (XRF) testing and their limitations.
